title: TX_SF announcement + RF-metrics DIO signaling absent (CCP-16 MUSTs, spec 02 3.5)
description: Reqs R-02-026, R-02-027. NOT-IMPLEMENTED. R-02-026: Gateways and nodes MUST announce current TX_SF in DIO options and Announce messages (1-byte field; absence means SF10) — rg tx_sf/current_tx_sf: zero implementation hits; no SF field in Announce construction (rust/lichen-rpl/src/announce.rs, C routing/announce.c, python link/ announce modules). R-02-027: ASSIGNED_SF and per-neighbor RF metrics (EMA SNR alpha=1/4, loss rate) MUST be signaled in DIO per CCP-16 — no DIO option carries EMA/density/utilization in any impl (C DIO registry rpl_messages.h:59-70 has no RF-metrics option). ASSIGNED_SF emission itself is tracked in sibling bead b7z9.71. Suggested placement: DIO option codecs in all three impls + announce app_data field; keep 1-byte absence-means-SF10 rule.
